items.reason: The admin app is a web app installed from the browser, not a Play listing; alert and camera permission are asked only when the owner taps; paying MettleUp is a business web payment on the payment company page; no health or ad claims in shell wording; WhatsApp sends are owner-tapped one-to-one links (opt-out gap already filed as FN-L12-panel-assistant-01). Play policy status: no issues.
The admin app has no App Store build; iPhone owners add the web app to the home screen through Safari (InstallCard steps).

Menu icons are MettleUp's own drawings, fonts are open-licence Google Fonts (Manrope, Sora, Space Grotesk), app icons are MettleUp brand files; no music, voices, clips or stock photos in this area. Owner logo rights already filed as FN-L12-panel-brand-shell-01. Whether the built bundle keeps open-source licence notices needs a build, not run on the laptop.
